test_title: PYST 54: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 08 Sept, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following was a major fiscal reform introduced in India as part of the 1991 economic reforms?

options.text: Introduction of the Modified Value Added Tax

solution:
The correct answer is __**Introduction of the Modified Value Added Tax**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Modified Value Added Tax (MODVAT) was introduced in India in 1991 as part of the economic reforms aimed at rationalizing the indirect tax structure.
 
• MODVAT allows manufacturers to receive credit for the excise duty paid on inputs used in the production of goods, reducing the cascading effect of taxation.
 
• It marked a significant step towards simplifying the tax regime and ensuring better compliance and efficiency in the indirect tax system.
 
• The introduction of MODVAT was designed to promote industrial growth by reducing production costs and encouraging investment in infrastructure and technology.
 
• This system laid the foundation for the Goods and Services Tax (GST) later introduced in 2017, which further streamlined the indirect taxation mechanism in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Introduction of GST:**

 
 
• The Goods and Services Tax (GST) was introduced in India on July 1, 2017, replacing multiple indirect taxes such as VAT, service tax, and excise duty.
 
• It is a comprehensive, destination-based tax system aimed at simplifying taxation and promoting a unified market across India.
 
 
 
• **Abolition of Wealth Tax:**
 
 
• The wealth tax was abolished in 2015 as part of efforts to simplify the tax structure and reduce compliance burdens.
 
• This tax was levied on the net wealth of individuals, Hindu Undivided Families (HUFs), and companies exceeding a specified limit.
 
 
 
• **Implementation of the FRBM Act:**
 
 
• The Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management (FRBM) Act was enacted in 2003 to ensure fiscal discipline and reduce India's fiscal deficit.
